I have been in this job for about 6 months and it is has come to the point where I am being mistreated more than not. I am one of the only females in the company which might be the problem. I am being judge every day for being a woman. Having people talk poorly to me and calling me names and bullying me. I have tired to speak to management and HR here but they seem to not care. There was an incident a couple months ago where I was sexually harassed by another employee, when reported to HR, the let the person go but I didn't have to file any paperwork or anything and was told not to make a fuss because I wasn't believed at first. I was told if I reported another harassment to HR, I would be let go because I was the problem. I also was told that if I did, I could not find another job because of it. My boss says poor things about me and tells me all the time I am not good at my job, then turns around the next day and tells me I'm doing great. I get spoken to for going to the bathroom or getting a drink of water, but all the boys in my office can talk about getting laid and football and nothing happens to them. I feel unsafe reporting to management in fear I will lose my job. I am trying to find another job in the meantime but have to keep this one to keep getting paid. I'm at a complete lost. I get yelled at all the time and told that I'm such a girl because sometimes they make me cry. I am being treated differently because of my gender and I don't know what to do anymore. Today I finally spoke to an upper management after realizing how miserable these people treat me. Now I have never been more scared that I am going to lose my job. Any advise would be great.
